name: libghostty-vt
compatibility_constraints: The public C API is incomplete and unstable; all calls remain behind Datum's TerminalCore adapter.
Ghostty has not tagged a libghostty-vt release; upgrades require a new exact commit, checksums, compiler pin, and compatibility corpus.
The verified production build host and target are x86_64 Linux and x86_64-linux-gnu; another platform requires an additional checksum-pinned toolchain entry and build proof.
libghostty-vt supplies terminal state and renderer-facing data, not Datum tabs, splits, PTY sessions, font shaping, pixels, accessibility, or shell integration.
All features stay enabled for Datum; trimming any feature is an explicit product-capability change.
Artifact bytes may encode absolute build/cache paths; source, toolchain, inputs, options, ABI smoke behavior, and tests are reproducible, but artifact SHA-256 is not a portable release identity.
